ValidationRule.description: QA fix (Defect #3): blocks moving a reservation backward out of Reserved/Expired/Converted/Cancelled into Requested/Pending Approval. Real system transitions never move backward, so this is untouched by legitimate automation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(AF_Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(AF_Status__c), "Reserved"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(AF_Status__c), "Expired"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(AF_Status__c), "Converted"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(AF_Status__c), "Cancelled") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Requested"), ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Pending Approval") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Illegal reservation status transition. A reservation cannot move backward from Reserved/Expired/Converted/Cancelled into Requested/Pending Approval.
